from ghidra.program.model.address import AddressSet
from ghidra.program.disassemble import Disassembler
af=currentProgram.getAddressFactory()
a=af.getAddress('142344ae0'); b=af.getAddress('142344c00')
tx=currentProgram.startTransaction('dis')
try:
    Disassembler.getDisassembler(currentProgram,monitor,None).disassemble(a,AddressSet(a,b),True)
finally:
    currentProgram.endTransaction(tx,True)
for ins in currentProgram.getListing().getInstructions(AddressSet(a,b), True):
    print(ins.getAddress(), ins.toString())
